bullets: Document SDKTemplate root-namespace reconciliation (PATTERNS.md + SKILL.md Step 1): Windows Universal Samples put the whole app in namespace SDKTemplate, so rename it tree-wide in one sweep and grep for residuals before building — a partial rename causes CS0246 + a cascading WMC9999 that breaks the entire build.

Add an orphaned-SDKTemplate residue check to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: fail deterministically (file:line) when a SDKTemplate reference remains but no file declares 'namespace SDKTemplate', catching a missed rename pre-build instead of via an opaque CS0246/WMC9999.
deferred_to_human: Optionally perform the SDKTemplate->project-namespace rename in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 at bootstrap time (or set scaffold <RootNamespace> to the sample namespace); changes bootstrap behavior, needs corpus-wide testing.
